description: Frozen Phase 7A crosswalk sample for the batch 12 utilities (October 9, 2026): every latest live record of the Alberta electricity utilities (wires and Rate of Last Resort), Ontario and Alberta gas and PUC Distribution Inc., reduced to the fields the crosswalk matches on (eligibility truncated to 200 characters). Complements rm_records_sample.json (pre-batch-12 export); tests must use these files, not site/data/rates.json.
selection: latest effective_date per (utility_name, name, customer_class), then provenance 'live'; province AB, Ontario gas, or utility PUC Distribution Inc.
